message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points come from the cards left in opponents’ hands when someone goes “UNO.” | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (red, yellow, green, blue) × 25 cards each (numbers 0‑9 + two of each action card), plus 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw Four). | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. | | **Turn order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately. | | **Action cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two and skips.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four and skips (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Winning a round** | When a player discards their last card they shout “UNO!” if they’re down to one card. If they forget, the next player must draw two penalty cards. | | **Scoring** | After a round ends, all other players add up the point values of the cards still in their hands:
• Number cards = face value
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 pts each
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 pts each
• The winner adds those points to their total. | | **Game end** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon score wins. | **Optional house rules** * Some groups allow “Stacking” (draw two or wild draw four can be countered with another of the same type). * Others let you play a Wild Draw Four even if you could play a normal card—just risk being challenged. That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak or add house rules to keep things interesting.
